ruleDefinitions.name: Potential AMSI Bypass Via .NET Reflection
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects Request to "amsiInitFailed" that can be used to disable AMSI Scanning

sequences.query: ((process_command_line = RGX(".*System\\\.Management\\\.Automation\\\.AmsiUtils.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*amsiInitFailed.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\[Ref\\]\\\.Assembly\\\.GetType.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*SetValue\\(\\$null\\,\\$true\\).*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*NonPublic\\,Static.*")))
